name: memory_context_pack
description: Sub-millisecond hierarchical memory context pack assembly fusing Working, Episodic, Semantic, Procedural, and Graph context within a strict token budget. Essential for real-time persona dialogue and high-throughput agent execution.

query.description: Active conversational turn or task prompt.

token_budget.description: Maximum token budget for assembled memory (default 3000).

profile.description: Cognitive scoring profile preset (e.g. BALANCED, RECALLING, THE_EXECUTOR).

persona_id.description: Persona identifier for sovereign RBAC and identity gating.

conflict_mode.description: Conflict resolution mode: MULTI_EVIDENCE, HIGHEST_CONFIDENCE, FAIL_CLOSED.
